decisions.decision: Drop the yes/no question. Adi already decided on 2026-10-08: he hosts in the normal Zoom app, and the team runs a Live Control web page with a control seat. Do these now: (1) Add the 5 poll scopes to the existing Tantra Centre app, as was done for T-232. (2) Generate a random ZOOM_BOT_KEY, set it with 'wrangler secret put', apply migration 0019 remotely, run 'npx wrangler deploy' in cloud/, then check that /bot/zoom/plan and /admin/control answer with the key. (3) Build the macOS seat app against the Meeting SDK with the credentials left empty: join, heartbeat, claim actions, chat, CTA, polls, mute, video, events. Also build REST poll creation, poll and chat events, the launchd plist and the probe. (4) Once Adi saves the SDK credentials, run the test meeting for the done-when checks. The seat uses the bot slot already counted inside the 100.
decisions.why: The board note of 2026-10-08 settles who hosts. Deploys and scopes on our own Zoom app have precedent (T-224, T-232 scope added 2026-10-08), and rule orchestrator-autonomy covers them. A new Meeting SDK app creates a new credential, which is on the never-approve list.

decisions.decision:
Delete the yes/no 'Asked of Adi' from T-226. Building the console needs no yes from Adi; the only real input is the SDK app, which is already its own task (T-335).
1) Add the 5 poll scopes to the Tantra Centre app in the browser already signed in to Zoom. Claude added a scope to this same app for T-232. Do not touch other settings.
2) Finish building: REST poll creation, /bot/zoom/events taking poll results and chat posts, and the macOS control seat built against the contract in zoom-control.ts and run against a simulated seat. Also the launchd job 20 minutes before Wed to Fri 11:00 ET, a probe, and a setup doc.
3) Apply migration 0019 to the live centre and deploy with 'npx wrangler deploy' in cloud/. Do not set ZOOM_BOT_KEY yet.
4) When T-335 delivers the Client ID and Secret, save them and run the test meeting. Set status review.
decisions.why: Adi's 2026-10-08 board note asks for a team Live Control page plus a seat, built without delays. Under orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted], deploying and adding scopes to our own app are Claude's calls. Credentials go on a separate input task (T-335).
